t: A container for liquids that can (by default) hold up to 32 buckets. It's possible to restrict the type of liquids by placing a bucket with the specific liquid in the filter slot
一种用于盛装流体的容器，（默认）最多可容纳 32 桶。你可以在过滤槽中放入装有指定流体的桶，以限制可存储的流体种类。
Right-click with buckets or other fluid containers to fill or drain the tank. Pipes can also interact with its fluid capability.
使用桶或其他流体容器对储罐进行右键点击，可实现填充或排空操作。管道亦可与其流体功能交互。
Put a filled bucket in the filter slot to lock the tank to that fluid. Remove the filter item to allow any fluid again.
在滤网槽中放入装满液体的桶，即可将储罐锁定为仅处理该种液体。移除滤网物品后，储罐将恢复为可处理任意液体。
